rules.title: CSRF protection disabled
rules.why: Disabling CSRF is safe only for stateless token APIs; for cookie sessions it allows cross-site requests.
rules.fix: Keep CSRF enabled for session-based apps.

rules.title: Every request is permitted without authentication
rules.why: anyRequest().permitAll() leaves everything not matched earlier public.

rules.title: @CrossOrigin allows every origin
rules.why: A wildcard origin lets any website call the endpoint from a browser.

rules.title: All actuator endpoints exposed
rules.why: Actuator endpoints such as env, heapdump and mappings leak configuration and memory.
